parsed.justification: The bottom player uses a butterfly hook to elevate the top player and rotates to secure back control.
The bottom player uses a butterfly hook and grip on the top player's arm to elevate and roll them over, successfully reversing the position to top.

The top player has their arm wrapped around the bottom player's neck in a rear-naked choke configuration, but the bottom player is successfully defending by hand fighting and keeping their chin tucked.
The top player is applying an armbar from the mount position, but the bottom player successfully defends by clasping their hands together to prevent the extension of the arm.
